Category: Seen Gods

Primarily Practiced In: Small pockets worldwide

Espirian Domains: The Hells (Mortum)

Synark’s form is long lost to time; in many older depictions he is a serpentlike being, but he is comprised of the bones of countless creatures who have perished and discarded their bodies to him. Many of his fiends and his worshippers align with the Hellish realm of Mortum, consigned with disgust at the desire for the sanctity of life, and the finality of death. As a result, many are brought back through vile methods and unholy powers as undead, allowing their souls to be whisked and transformed into unholy creations, while their bones are sacrificed to the ever-growing deity. Worship of Synark typically, truly begins upon reaching this threshold of death. Many of the siblings find Synark a useful but also unreliable ally, but Synark’s goal is sensible in that he only desires to take the bones of the dead in the battlefields of the Eternal Strife. But the siblings understand that they must be careful, that the souls of those who perish should not have agreed to terms or desire their death so that they can serve Synark in undeath; for that will be an enemy in the future for their own forces.

Title Skeleton of Impermanent Death

Edicts Pursue avenues to spit on mortality such as extending your lifespan or raise undead.        

Anathema Putting the dead to rest, revive a creature to mortality

Areas of Concern Death, undeath, bones

Religious Symbol An arrangement of bovid skeletons

Sacred Animal Worms

Sacred Colors black, green and teal
